The lesson still recalls earlier lessons where they apply: 第7回 in s1-lead, 第2回 in s3-mode and 第8回 in s3-table.

measure.mjs reports 「prose 2260 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 2648 · practice reading 1225 · questions 11 · practice sections 2 · est 19.9 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 20)」, and lint --strict reports 0 warnings. Re-scored for the e3 change. Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer and gives a reason. All 7 brief misconceptions are still used as distractors across hook-predict, q1–q4 and the exam.
